own_solution.law: Terminal velocity under Stokes drag: 6 pi eta r v = (m - rho_l V) g, V = (4/3) pi r^3
assumptions: liquid at rest, far from walls
sphere volume fixed by its 2 mm radius

defect_reasons.rendering_not_minimal: TEAB4 and T3D94 say 'a small amount' where their counterparts state 0.09 g, so they do not carry the same number if meant as variants.

notes: V = 3.35103e-8 m^3; buoyant mass 0.042223 g; net mass 0.207777 g; net force 2.03622e-3 N; 6 pi eta r = 0.0376991 N s/m; v = 0.054013 m/s. With +0.09 g: net 0.297777 g, v = 0.077408 m/s (Re ~ 0.39, still Stokes). TB5DB 'just before this release ... for one release only' applies to the current release, so R. TEAB4/TFAF0 refer to an earlier release only (D).
